scope:
Build a Gram cover ONLY for a root minimizing 9s+8g globally.

The supplied integer certificate removes template 7 at that chosen root.
Projection reports may remove Gram selectors only after an exhaustive
INFEASIBLE terminal call on all selectors not previously retained.
The arbitrary-root frontier and its Gram rows are never overwritten.

records.pair_signature_scope:
Exact pairwise Schur and short-lattice cuts for a variable Gram cover.

The existing individual/corner tables define every signature state. For each
Gram, forbid only pairs violating a two-by-two principal minor of either
conditional projector, or the proved integral short-vector overlap bounds.
All arithmetic is integral. No Gram or vertex signature is selected as seed.

corner_orientation_factorization.scope:
Factor a corner table through auxiliary square orientations.

All eight square orientations remain existentially available, independently
in each rectangle. This is a local table encoding, not a normalization of
graph vertices and not an assumed graph automorphism. Completeness of every
table orbit is checked before replacing it by its canonical representative.

corner_table_reuse.scope:
Restrict existing exact corner tables to an unchanged subset of Gram values.

No Gram is excluded here. The anchor frame, lift, template and root budget
must agree exactly. Table selectors are remapped by their complete anchor
value tuple; catalog state indices are retained unchanged.
